title: Early Experience：从模仿学习到强化学习的双分支训练范式

nodes.label: Expert Dataset D_expert
nodes.semantic_desc: Expert demonstrations consisting of state-action pairs {(s_i, a_i)}; provides expert states s_i and corresponding expert actions a_i for data construction and supervised policy training.
nodes.visual_desc: A dataset cylinder icon labeled 'D_expert' with a small two-column table sketch inside: left column s_i, right column a_i.

nodes.label: Initial LLM Policy
nodes.semantic_desc: Initial language-model policy used as a proposal distribution; takes state s_i (as prompt/representation) and outputs sampled candidate actions {a_i^1..a_i^K}.
nodes.visual_desc: A rounded rectangle module with subtle transformer-block glyphs (stacked layers) and centered text 'Initial LLM Policy'.

nodes.label: K Candidate Actions
nodes.semantic_desc: Non-expert alternative actions sampled for each expert state; outputs an action set {a_i^1, a_i^2, ..., a_i^K} used for environment rollouts and comparisons.
nodes.visual_desc: A fan-out list icon showing K small action tokens/cards labeled a^1, a^2, ..., a^K arranged in a row.

nodes.label: Environment Rollout
nodes.semantic_desc: Simulation/execution module; takes (s_i, action) and outputs the resulting next/ भविष्य state s'. Used for executing both expert action a_i and candidate actions a_i^j.
nodes.visual_desc: A rounded rectangle labeled 'Environment' with a simple trajectory arrow icon entering and exiting (state → action → next state).

nodes.label: Expert Next State s_{i+1}
nodes.semantic_desc: Next state obtained by executing expert action a_i from s_i; serves as reference outcome for self-reflection comparisons.
nodes.visual_desc: A single state node (small circle) with a bold arrow from 'a_i' tag; rendered as a clean glyph (no heavy text).

nodes.label: Candidate Next States s_i^j
nodes.semantic_desc: Next states obtained by executing each sampled candidate action a_i^j from s_i; provides outcome supervision for IWM and contrast targets for SR.
nodes.visual_desc: A set of small state circles (j=1..K) arranged as multiple branches from the same origin, indicating different futures.

nodes.label: Rollout Triples D_rollout
nodes.semantic_desc: Constructed rollout dataset containing triples {(s_i, a_i^j, s_i^j)}; feeds the implicit world modeling branch as supervised training data without rewards.
nodes.visual_desc: A dataset cylinder labeled 'D_rollout' with a tiny 3-field tuple sketch: (s, a^j, s^j).

nodes.label: Future State Supervision
nodes.semantic_desc: Reward-free supervision signal using predicted-vs-actual future state; takes target s_i^j and defines the learning signal for dynamics internalization.
nodes.visual_desc: A target/bullseye icon over a small state glyph, suggesting 'predict next state' supervision (no reward icon).

nodes.label: Implicit World Modeling (IWM)
nodes.semantic_desc: World-modeling training branch; takes (s_i, a_i^j) from D_rollout and outputs predicted future state tokens \hat{s}_i^j via next-token prediction to internalize environment dynamics.
nodes.visual_desc: A rounded rectangle with label 'IWM' and a small 's,a → s'' schematic inside (minimal glyph).

nodes.label: NLL Loss (IWM)
nodes.semantic_desc: Negative log-likelihood objective; takes predicted future-state token distribution and target future state tokens s_i^j, outputs a scalar loss for IWM optimization.
nodes.visual_desc: A small loss box with '−log p(·)' math glyph and a downward arrow indicating minimization.

nodes.label: Self-Reflection (SR)
nodes.semantic_desc: Reflection generation branch; takes s_i along with outcomes from expert action (s_{i+1}) and candidate actions (s_i^j) and outputs natural-language critiques/explanations c_i^j stating why the expert action is better.
nodes.visual_desc: A rounded rectangle labeled 'SR' with a speech-bubble icon and a tiny comparison glyph (two futures side-by-side).

nodes.label: Reflection Text c_i^j
nodes.semantic_desc: Natural language explanations produced per candidate action; describes preference for expert action over a_i^j, used as supervised targets in reflection finetuning.
nodes.visual_desc: A speech bubble containing 2–3 short gray lines (placeholder text strokes) to indicate generated explanation text.

nodes.label: Reflection Dataset D_refl
nodes.semantic_desc: Constructed dataset of tuples {(s_i, a_i^j, c_i^j)}; provides supervised pairs for training the policy to generate reflections conditioned on state and candidate action.
nodes.visual_desc: A dataset cylinder labeled 'D_refl' with a small tuple sketch: (s, a^j, c).

nodes.label: Joint Policy Training
nodes.semantic_desc: Unified finetuning stage; takes D_expert and D_refl (and optionally IWM-updated parameters) and trains a single LLM policy to predict expert actions a_i and reflection texts c_i^j.
nodes.visual_desc: A larger rounded rectangle with two small input icons (dataset cylinders) feeding into it; centered text 'Joint Training'.

nodes.label: Trained LLM Policy
nodes.semantic_desc: Final policy after Early Experience training; outputs both action decisions (imitating expert) and reflection/explanation tokens, serving as the IL→RL bridging policy.
nodes.visual_desc: A transformer-style module icon with a checkmark badge; two output ports labeled as small glyphs: 'action token' and 'text bubble'.
